messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - billing/metering anomaly detected. Shadow ledger token delta spike (service: emitter-proxy). Overages flagged for subset of customers. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/billing-metering
sam_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Any visible customer impact? Which region?
mike_prod: EU customers receiving overage emails, CS pinged. Observed emitter retries spiking after 503s from billing-validate. curl log snippet:
```
curl -v https://billing-validate.internal/validate -d '{"tokens":...}'

503 Service Unavailable
``` 
carla_sre: checking kafka consumer lag -> 12m behind on emitter-topic. Likely replay/duplication. I'll pause retries on proxy.
sam_oncall: Applying mitigation: set EMITTER_RETRY_POLICY=fast-fail (backoff 1s, max 1) and pause emitter-proxy. Command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/emitter-proxy EMITTER_RETRY_POLICY=1s:1 && kubectl scale deploy/emitter-proxy --replicas=0
```
@jess_custsuccess please hold customer notices until we confirm root cause :pray:
jess_custsuccess: on it — drafting targeted note for affected customers, waiting for ops confirmation. Will not send bulk emails.
eng-ops-bot: Deploy triggered: rollback commit 9a8b7c -> rolling restart billing-validate (see CI: https://ci/redwood/987)
carla_sre: quick dedupe query showing dup token emits for sample user ids:
```
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as emits FROM shadow_ledger
WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;
```
mike_prod: root cause: retry loop + consumer replay after transient outage. Recent change to retry policy 2hr ago increased aggressive retries. Reverting that change now.
sam_oncall: restarting billing-validate. Monitoring metering counts and overage flag suppression. Temporarily suppress threshold alerting for bulk emails.
incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-0421 created. Paging window open. :white_check_mark:
jess_custsuccess: update: sending targeted "we're investigating" to 3 customers; will send reversal email after counts reconcile.
carla_sre: shadow vs ledger delta dropping from +18% to +1. Backfill/dedupe running. ETA 22m.
sam_oncall: plan: re-enable emitter-proxy after dedupe completes and confirm delta < 2%. Follow ups: postmortem owner @carla_sre, contact list for customers updated. Closing mitigation in 30m unless regress.
carla_sre: :thumbsup: will own postmortem and include timeline + metric rollbacks. closing check in 30m.
